note: Known differences between the real-machine baseline (Chrome 157, Windows 11, GTX 1080 Ti) and Nya windows mode. Every entry carries the reason it is accepted.

missing.Arial Narrow: Ships with Microsoft Office, not with Windows.

fontMetrics.Malgun Gothic/symbols: Symbol glyphs fall back to Segoe UI Symbol; DirectWrite and FreeType hint its bounds differently.

mediaQueries.(any-pointer: coarse): The baseline machine has a touchscreen; Nya models a mouse-only desktop.

misc.maxTouchPoints: The baseline machine has a touchscreen; Nya models a mouse-only desktop.

hostMedia.reason: Hardware video capabilities come from the host GPU (Media Foundation / NVDEC on Windows, --nya-os-hw-video on Nya). They are compared exactly when the host GPU matches the baseline and skipped (MED-HW) otherwise.

voices.reason: Network voices depend on the browser vendor and connectivity.

audio.context.state: An AudioContext starts running only after user activation (autoplay policy); the baseline page had been clicked.

devices.mediaDevices.devices: The baseline machine has no camera; Nya models one webcam. Masking is checked by DEV-02.

identity.hardwareConcurrency: Per-session fingerprint value; checked by HW-01.
identity.deviceMemory: Per-session fingerprint value; checked by HW-02.

contexts.serviceWorker: The baseline browser refused to register the service worker over the probe's self-signed certificate.

headers.host: Probe server address differs per run.
headers.referer: Probe server address differs per run.
headers.cache-control: Depends on how the page was loaded (reload vs. typed navigation).
headers.sec-fetch-site: Depends on how the page was loaded (reload vs. typed navigation).
headers.sec-fetch-user: Depends on how the page was loaded (reload vs. typed navigation).
headers.device-memory: Per-session fingerprint value; checked by HW-02.
headers.sec-ch-device-memory: Per-session fingerprint value; checked by HW-02.
headers.sec-ch-viewport-width: The baseline window was restored, Nya is maximized; checked against innerWidth instead.

extensions.WEBGL_draw_buffers: ANGLE's EGL backend on Linux is GLES-only and does not expose EXT_draw_buffers to WebGL 1 contexts (D3D11 does); exposing it means replacing the GPU backend.
extensions.OVR_multiview2: ANGLE's EGL backend on Linux binds OpenGL ES only, and ANGLE gates this extension on desktop-GL driver features; exposing it means replacing the GPU backend.
extensions.WEBGL_provoking_vertex: ANGLE's EGL backend on Linux binds OpenGL ES only, and ANGLE gates this extension on desktop-GL driver features; exposing it means replacing the GPU backend.
